## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION — Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive; narrow leadership and mixed internals warrant restraint. Confirmation 1: Top-5 leadership concentrated in Technology (4/5), Confirmation 2: Major divergence across large-cap names (multiple RECOVERY vs ABOVE TREND signals) — watch for trend breaks.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology leads: MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.59% | 1M: +30.08%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.44%), ORCL ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.21% | 1M: +2.30%). Materials and Industrials follow: NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +20.56% | 1M: +19.16%), CAT RECOVERY (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -10.09%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy, Utilities and Real Estate are lagging: XOM CORRECTION (1W: -1.54% | 1M: +11.33%), SRE BELOW TREND (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -11.35%), VST BELOW TREND (1W: -5.13% | 1M: -11.01%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: PLTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +39.78% | 1M: +33.30%), SHOP ABOVE TREND (1W: +29.38% | 1M: +23.06%), NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +20.56% | 1M: +19.16%), QCOM RECOVERY (1W: +13.72% | 1M: -12.17%), ORCL ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.21% | 1M: +2.30%). Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: MNST BELOW TREND (1W: -6.25% | 1M: -6.41%), CVS BELOW TREND (1W: -8.36% | 1M: -6.34%), MAR BELOW TREND (1W: -5.07% | 1M: -4.98%), SRE BELOW TREND (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -11.35%), VLO CORRECTION (1W: -4.66% | 1M: +6.48%). Weakness concentrated in Utilities/Consumer Stpl. and pockets of Consumer Disc.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Big 1W momentum: PLTR (1W: +39.78% | 1M: +33.30%), SHOP (1W: +29.38% | 1M: +23.06%), QCOM (1W: +13.72% | 1M: -12.17%). Note divergence: several high-momentum names (QCOM, INTC) are RECOVERY — tactical momentum but not uniform monthly confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech shows strength but concentrated winners; NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.44%), MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.59% | 1M: +30.08%), AAPL RECOVERY (1W: +1.43% | 1M: -0.91%). Sector breadth: 18/24 positive (Sector Strength) — but leadership narrow, so selective exposure favored.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are modestly constructive with mixed internals; JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.63% | 1M: +6.57%), V CORRECTION (1W: -0.99% | 1M: +4.11%), MA CORRECTION (1W: -1.77% | 1M: +7.60%). Sector breadth: 12/20 positive (Internal Rotation) — supportive but not dominant.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare is mixed with defensive names holding while others lag; JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +0.05%), UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -1.77% | 1M: -5.70%), LLY RECOVERY (1W: +3.21% | 1M: -2.57%). Sector breadth: 10/17 positive (Internal Rotation); monitor drug/approval headlines for directional moves.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective Technology winners and cyclical Materials/Industrials while reducing exposure to single-stock concentration risk in narrow leadership. Reduce exposure to Utilities/Energy laggards and monitor RECOVERY names for confirmation before expanding core positions.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.44%), MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.59% | 1M: +30.08%), PLTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +39.78% | 1M: +33.30%) — watch for follow-through. BEARISH: CVS BELOW TREND (1W: -8.36% | 1M: -6.34%), MAR BELOW TREND (1W: -5.07% | 1M: -4.98%), CVX CORRECTION (1W: -5.22% | 1M: +7.19%).

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (breadth strong, 18/24 positive), Materials (9/11 positive) and Industrials (11/15 positive) for cyclical rotation. BEARISH: Energy (2/10 positive), Utilities (2/10 positive) and Real Estate (3/10 positive) where downside persists.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA: hold above the recent 1W high to confirm ABOVE TREND continuation; AAPL: failure to reclaim 1M gains keeps it in RECOVERY — watch next-week follow-through; JPM: extension above this week’s highs would reinforce sector support and ABOVE TREND momentum.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LLY (+80): LLY RECOVERY (1W: +3.21% | 1M: -2.57%) — FDA breakthrough headline aligns with a short-term bounce (confirming). CAT (+80): CAT RECOVERY (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -10.09%) — earnings/guidance positive but monthly divergence suggests watch for follow-through.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
CVS (-45): CVS BELOW TREND (1W: -8.36% | 1M: -6.34%) — negative fee cut headline confirms price weakness. MAR (-45): MAR BELOW TREND (1W: -5.07% | 1M: -4.98%) — revenue miss sentiment confirmed by price; monitor for further downside.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION regime with Growth/Momentum style tilting in leadership but narrow concentration in Technology. MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.59% | 1M: +30.08%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.44%), PLTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +39.78% | 1M: +33.30%) showing relative strength. Key risk: narrow leadership and major divergence across large caps — monitor RECOVERY names and headline-driven movers (LLY, CAT, CVS) for confirmation.
